title: Environment feedback
current_gap: The environment/visual authority decision is approved, but static queries, contact response, dynamic changes and an environment-specific raw freeze/recovery audit are not implemented.

atoms.name: static_terrain_scene
atoms.required: Versioned scene/hash, ENU/metre geometry, origin, query and startup rejection

atoms.name: dynamic_environment_changes
atoms.required: Authority-time updates, ordering, validity and collision behavior

atoms.name: feedback_freshness_expiry
atoms.required: Step/epoch/interval validity and explicit stale result

atoms.name: joint_freeze_recovery
atoms.required: Environment-specific freeze at committed boundary and explicit recovery

atoms.name: ue_rgb_mirror_separation
atoms.required: Shared manifest and proof display loss cannot alter physics

decision.physics_authority: WSL static terrain/collision and authoritative physics step
decision.visual_mirror: UE same manifest/hash, asynchronous RGB with epoch/step/time/pose/calibration
decision.expiry: required dynamic feedback expiry freezes affected joint scene and requires explicit recovery
decision.epoch_mutation: static configuration is immutable within an epoch
